name: Agent402
description: Agent402 model provider: auto-routed and explicit frontier models at a flat per-call price, paid by card (prepaid credits key) or in USDC over x402. Same key reaches 500+ pay-per-call tools.

creditsKey.description: Agent402 prepaid credits key (a402_...). Precedence: this, then AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY, then ~/.openclaw/agent402/credits.key.

walletKey.description: Optional EVM private key for x402 USDC payment (needs @x402/fetch + @x402/evm + viem installed). Precedence: this, then AGENT402_WALLET_KEY, then the wallet `setup` generates at ~/.openclaw/agent402/wallet.key.

pricing.description: metered (default): explicit models pay a per-request quote; flat: every model on its flat tier.
